prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Spotlight Layout for Pet Generation Screen: Redesign the pet generation waiting screen into a spotlight layout that focuses user attention on active pet generation progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pet Choice Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a carousel layout to showcase selectable pets in a focused, interactive visual format.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel"}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Customization Style Preview Screen: Insert a new style preview screen before photo upload to display visual style examples of generated custom pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_style_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_style_preview": {"headline": "Preview Pet Styles", "body": "See sample art styles before uploading your custom photo.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Sign In Flow: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate completion instead of before pet selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Layout for Intro Screen: Update the story screen to use a story_scroll layout for smoother reading of background lore.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll"}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Stage Checklist: Add a checklist component to the waiting screen detailing generation steps like rendering art and generating personality traits.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "1. Rendering pet art\n2. Building pet personality\n3. Preparing desktop environment", "style": "calm"}]}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Tray Control Hint: Add a hint to the home intro screen showing users how to control or hide their pet using the system taskbar tray icon.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Click the desktop taskbar icon anytime to summon, hide, or talk to your pet."}}
7: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to advise returning users to log in with their original account method to keep pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Welcome Back to Your Pet", "body": "Please sign in using your existing account to restore your saved desktop pets."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Sound Notification: Add an audio component to the waiting screen that plays a gentle chime when pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:completion_chime", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [finish, incentive] First Day Interaction Badge Reward: Add a visual adoption badge component on the home_intro screen celebrating successful completion of pet adoption.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Owner", "style": "playful"}]}}
